packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR; they are low risk and noisy individually.
Group non-major Go module bumps; majors stay separate so they get a real review. Talos is excluded here: a later groupName: null does not ungroup it.
Talos machinery drives the certificate-issuing path — never batch it with anything else.
Without bump, Renovate treats the go directive as a minimum and never raises it. Must be its own rule: rangeStrategy cannot be combined with matchUpdateTypes.
Keep the Go directive on a patched release. govulncheck scans the standard library of whatever toolchain go.mod pins, so a stale patch version fails CI on its own — let the bot keep it current.
